title: Report: Peyton Manning is not expected to be a candidate for Colts G.M. job

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Peyton Manning is not expected to be a candidate for Colts G.M. job
sources.description: When the Colts G.M. job became vacant six days ago, former Colts quarterback Peyton Manning was one of the first names to be mentioned.
